dataset.name: google/fleurs
dataset.attribution: FLEURS: Few-shot Learning Evaluation of Universal Representations of Speech, Alexis Conneau and collaborators, Google Research, 2022; distributed by google/fleurs on Hugging Face under CC-BY-4.0.

selection.method: Eight new clips chosen and frozen before any recognition on them. Sentence IDs are distinct from all eight ASR development clips and from each other. Five Greek and three English cover ordinary speech, a proper name, numerals, uncertainty and negation.
selection.representativeness: Purposive read-speech diagnostic sample, not random population validation or a conversational/noisy speech benchmark.
selection.dataset_access_note: Attempts to fetch the test-split preview returned HTTP 500; distinct previously unselected validation-split rows were used instead.

audio_preparation: Downloaded the dataset viewer audio renditions unchanged. These are native recorded speech, not synthesized speech. Viewer audio encoding may differ from the original dataset container; exact downloaded bytes are identified by SHA-256. No trimming, enhancement or reference-conditioned decoding is performed.

archive_provenance.checksum_scope: Existing report/manifest/source-report checksum fields refer to the original raw evidence. Sanitized artifact checksums are listed in artifact-index.json.
archive_provenance.transformations: Removed machine-local cache, artifact and dataset-extraction paths; made manifest paths relative; stripped signed URL query parameters if present. Reference text, hypotheses, judgments, numerical results and model/source hashes were preserved.
